beforeImage.name: CleanCapital Holdings, LLC
beforeImage.description: CleanCapital Holdings LLC develops, acquires, owns and operates distributed solar and energy-storage projects across the United States. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, the platform serves commercial, industrial, institutional, utility and public-sector counterparties through contracted clean-energy assets. Current company materials report more than 350 projects and approximately 500 MW, with over US$1.5 billion invested. BlackRock Renewable Power Group funds made a direct investment in 2019, but that period is historical and the exact stake and exit date are not publicly disclosed. Manulife Investment Management made a corporate investment in 2021 and remains the only named current institutional backer; its exact percentage is not publicly disclosed. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a GIP ownership period. CleanCapital sold the 120 MW Nottingham development in April 2026 as an asset-level transaction and no platform sale or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.

afterImage.name: CleanCapital Holdings, LLC
afterImage.description: CleanCapital Holdings, LLC develops, acquires, owns and operates distributed solar and energy-storage projects across the United States. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, the platform serves commercial, industrial, institutional, utility and public-sector counterparties through contracted clean-energy assets. Generate Capital and CleanCapital established a project-acquisition warehouse in 2017 targeting approximately US$300 million of operating clean-energy assets; this was project-level financing and ownership rather than disclosed corporate equity, and Generate's exact project stake and exit date were not publicly disclosed. BlackRock Renewable Power Group funds made a direct corporate investment in 2019, but that period is historical. Manulife Investment Management made a corporate investment in 2021 through Manulife Infrastructure Fund II and remains the only named current institutional backer. The exact Manulife and former BlackRock percentages are not publicly disclosed. Infranity's January 2026 capital is a holdco debt facility, and no platform sale or signed ownership exit was identified through August 29, 2026.
